LanguageData.ChokingOnBlood.label: choking on blood
LanguageData.ChokingOnBlood.description: Blood obstructs breathing and can cause fatal cerebral hypoxia. Stop bleeding and clear the airway with suction; CPR provides weaker emergency clearance. Conscious patients may cough it clear themselves.

LanguageData.ChokingOnTourniquet.label: choking on tourniquet
LanguageData.ChokingOnTourniquet.description: A misapplied tourniquet is causing suffocation. Remove it immediately.
